name: book-guidelines
description: Book-derived engineering guidelines (Clean Code, Clean Architecture, PoEAA, HPJP, Modern Software Engineering, Philosophy of Software Design) plus PR-review/prototyping/behavioral skills, shared across all of Ingo's projects instead of copy-pasted per scaffold. Release It! and the stack-agnostic core of Use the Platform are injected at every session start via a hook; stack-specific Use the Platform companions (JVM, browser, Node.js, PHP) trigger contextually like the other book skills.
